# TaffyGo

> Free, open-source AI-native Chromium browser for Android, with one assistant, Taffy. No account needed. Matterward Labs runs no server for the app.

Published by Matterward Labs Private Limited.

## TaffyGo | Open-source AI-native browser for Android
https://taffygo.com/
TaffyGo is a free, open-source AI-native browser for Android. Block ads and trackers, browse with Taffy, and bring your own AI provider. No account needed.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/index.md

## Hand Taffy an errand | TaffyGo
https://taffygo.com/product/
One errand in TaffyGo from start to finish, in screens from a phone: you pick the pages, Taffy works in its own tabs while you watch, and the result names its sources.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/product.md

## Built for phones | TaffyGo
https://taffygo.com/built-for-phones/
Back, forward, Ask Taffy and your tabs sit in one row at the bottom, and the tabs Taffy opens are grouped apart from yours.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/built-for-phones.md

## AI-native browser use cases: documents, forms and research | TaffyGo
https://taffygo.com/use-cases/
Try TaffyGo’s interactive document and banking demos: website navigation, verification handovers, local image resizing, and form approval.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/use-cases.md

## AI providers and models for Android browsing | TaffyGo
https://taffygo.com/providers/
Explore all 38 provider entries and 667 models in TaffyGo’s catalog. Search Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. Connect your own key or plan.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/providers.md

## Chromium, Rust and on-device Python | TaffyGo
https://taffygo.com/technology/
Explore TaffyGo’s native Android interface, Chromium browser, sandboxed Rust core, and integrated on-device Python runtime.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/technology.md

## Contact | TaffyGo
https://taffygo.com/contact/
Report a bug or ask a question on GitHub, and report a security problem privately there. TaffyGo has no support inbox and no contact form.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/contact.md

## Privacy policy | TaffyGo
https://taffygo.com/privacy/
TaffyGo keeps your data on your phone. Matterward Labs runs no server for it, collects nothing from the app and has no account for you to make.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/privacy.md

## Delete your data | TaffyGo
https://taffygo.com/delete-my-data/
Matterward Labs holds no data about you, so there is nothing on our side to delete. This is how to clear what TaffyGo keeps on your phone.
Markdown: https://taffygo.com/delete-my-data.md

## Product boundaries

The Android build includes an embedded Python worker for registered document and spreadsheet tools; its phone-level execution checks remain pending. Government-document and banking demos use sample data and are not verified end-to-end phone runs. Model catalog inclusion does not guarantee provider access. AI requests go directly to the chosen provider and may incur provider charges.

Crawling, retrieval, and training on first-party public site content are allowed: https://taffygo.com/ai-policy.txt
